what: Derived data of the frozen intake surface v1 that the Rust intake (crates/abep-intake) reads instead of running scipy: the reference's own Qhull Delaunay triangulation of the v1 grid and scipy's search structures over it. Rust never needs scipy, Qhull or Python at runtime.
why: abep_sim.intake_tpmc.IntakeSurface interpolates with scipy LinearNDInterpolator(rescale=True). The v1 grid is a full tensor product, so the Delaunay problem is degenerate and the reference interpolant is defined by the simplices Qhull returned, which are non-conforming across some interior grid faces (finding B2-OF-01, docs/rust_migration/contracts/C-ABEP_SIM_INTAKE_TPMC_PY/finding_B2-OF-01_face_survey_v1.json). Parity therefore requires the reference triangulation and scipy's simplex search, not a re-triangulation.

artifacts.content: 120 grid points (CSV order), rescale offset (mean) and scale (ptp), 830 simplices, 259 degenerate flags
per simplex barycentric transform (null = degenerate), neighbours, lifted facet equations; paraboloid scale / shift; min / max bound; bound to the triangulation artifact by its sha256

derivation.reference_construction: abep_sim.intake._tpmc_surface: pandas.read_csv(frozen CSV) -> rows of one scattering kernel -> abep_sim.intake_tpmc.IntakeSurface -> per species and column (eta_c, C_D, CR_passive, K_back, mass_kg) scipy.interpolate.LinearNDInterpolator(rows[L_over_d, phi, alpha, theta_deg], column, rescale=True)
derivation.identity_check: all 30 interpolators (2 scattering x 3 species x 5 columns) have bitwise identical points, offset, scale, simplices, degenerate flags, transforms, neighbours, equations, paraboloid scale / shift and bounds; the capture is written only if they do

tools.pandas: 3.0.2 (default C-engine float converter; 17 CSV cells parse 1 ulp off correctly rounded, contract DIV-05; the captured point coordinates are exact grid values)
tools.qhull_options: Delaunay mode ('d') with scipy.spatial.Delaunay's default options for ndim <= 4, 'Qbb Qc Qz Q12', plus the always-required 'Qt' (triangulated output)

generator.run_from: the repository root, in the Python reference environment above
generator.history: the triangulation artifact was first written by the script version committed in 9e1a302; the version above (committed in ed6b27a) also writes the search artifact and reproduces the triangulation artifact byte-identically
generator.reproduction_check: 2026-10-05: re-running the command at 554bc94 rewrote both artifacts with unchanged sha256

consumer_rule: crates/abep-intake/src/frozen.rs reads each artifact with abep_provenance::read_verified against the pinned sha256; any mismatch is AbepError::HashMismatch (status MODEL_ERROR) and the surface is not built; there is no fallback and no re-triangulation. The loader then checks the artifacts against the frozen CSV (points and order, rescale recomputed bitwise, cell tiling, degenerate flags, transform cross-check, neighbour symmetry, bounds).
change_rule: never regenerated casually: a different frozen surface, scipy / Qhull version or option set is a new artifact version (v2) with its own provenance, new pinned sha256 and a new parity contract version; the end state keeps these files as versioned evidence data (A9.29 sec. 11) and needs no Python to read them
finding: B2-OF-01 (property of the frozen Python reference, not of the Rust port): docs/rust_migration/contracts/C-ABEP_SIM_INTAKE_TPMC_PY/finding_B2-OF-01_face_survey_v1.json
